title: 9:16 close chest-up portrait of an East
prompt:
9:16 close chest-up portrait of an East Asian woman about 24, small oval face, wet almond eyes looking through lashes, dark slender brows, straight nose, thin glossy pink lips caught mid-bite on the lower lip, even bright skin hot at the ears, chestnut bob. Aroused expression: she looks at the lens the way someone looks at a mouth they want, then catches herself and keeps looking anyway.
Dim indoor room. Light-blue gingham cami. She faces the camera, lean held halfway. No model posing.
Camera right in front, very slight tilt, 50mm, about 28cm from her face, subject about 91% of frame, face a little left of center. Dark room is a mute gray mass.
Low even room light, no shafts. Color about 47% skin, 23% gingham, 15% hair, 15% dark room. Photorealistic snapshot.
